{{Quote|Yer planetary leadership has abandoned you. They've ceded yer world to our cause&hellip;|[[General/Legends|General]] [[Whorm Loathsom/Legends|Whorm Loathsom]], to the [[Christophsian/Legends|Christophsian]] populace|<ref name="The Clone Wars: Shadowed">''[[The Clone Wars: Shadowed]]''</ref>}}
A merchant-led '''oligarchy''' ruled the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]] leading up to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. When the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|invaded]] Christophsis, the members of the [[oligarchy]] abandoned the world, leaving its remaining inhabitants to appeal to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] for aid.
